**Jan-16-2024**

[Dan C] I will be uploading and scheduling (weekly on Mondays early a.m.) two workflows on the GCS server. These workflows email enablement status reports (see attached for an example) to CSEs and managers and are named as follows:

- CSE Enablement Digest
- Manager Enablement Digest

These reports have been requested by Support management and have already been run manually for the last several weeks.
